summary: Comprehensive frontend-only smoke + interaction test of BHULLOK (Expo/React Native web preview) at 390x844 mobile viewport. Main menu, How-to-Play overlay, Codex (all 4 tabs), Scene Select, and all 11 story jumps mount without runtime errors. Gun combat verified end-to-end (ammo 8/8 -> 2/8 after 6 auto-locked shots, dodge + pause overlay + quit-to-menu work). Explore scene mounts with joystick + interact-button correctly disabled initially. Escape mini-game mounts with tap button and struggle meter visible. Melee scene: light/heavy/block/dodge all respond, monsters HP bar renders. Boss scene: boss-hp-bar + stagger-bar render, dodge/block/light/heavy all respond, no crashes. No console errors, no red screens, no uncaught exceptions across all scenes.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx / codex.tsx / scenes.tsx are clean, use StyleSheet, all interactive elements have kebab-case testIDs, and React Native components only (View/Text/Pressable). No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) detected in referenced game files.
GameProvider dispatch actions (RESET / GRANT / SET_CHECKPOINT / GOTO) used from Scene Select work correctly - state transitions cleanly into /game and mounts the right scene each time.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is served at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://combat-logic-game.preview.emergentagent.com). Use /scenes to jump directly to any beat rather than replaying prologue. All testIDs are kebab-case and match request spec. Auto-lock in gun combat takes ~1-3s to acquire a bat; poll fire-button aria-disabled before clicking. Damage popups animate quickly (<400ms) - to verify them, poll aggressively or read them via screenshot rather than text queries. StatBar-based meters (struggle-meter, player-hp-bar, boss-hp-bar) do NOT expose aria-valuenow on web; verify by presence + visual/screenshot only.
